label: Post cards
description: The blog's post grid. Each card carries the topic the platform filter behaviour reads, so the topic chips need no script, and the grid owns the “no posts in this topic” message the behaviour reveals when a chip matches nothing. A card with no thumbnail set draws an empty placeholder the same size as the photograph, so adding one later does not move the card. The cards mirror site/blog/posts/ — add one here when a post is published.

props.label: Message when a topic has no posts
props.default: No posts in this topic yet.

fields.label: Topic — must match a chip value
